C api007.unexpected-propagate OL API-007 DEFAULT ;; Programming defects and unexpected database/external failures propagate to the global exception handler. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api021.aborted-separately OL API-021 MUST ;; The global handler treats client-aborted requests (RequestAborted) separately from failures. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api008.dev-diagnostics OL API-008 MUST ;; Development tooling may expose more; public API contracts stay safe. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api001.map-in-api OL API-001 MUST ;; Map Application outcome categories to HTTP in the API layer. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep010.di-extensions OL DEP-010 DECIDED ;; Register validators with FluentValidation.DependencyInjectionExtensions. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.validation-invocation EX API-010 MUST ;; Follow the project's established validation invocation pattern rather than adding a second competing mechanism. ;; = ;; none ;; Single-mechanism rule not in the oracle.
C api010.not-replace-business OL API-010,ARC-003 MUST ;; API validation does not replace business rules; CRUD/workflow/orchestration rules stay in Application unless an approved richer Domain design. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api007.no-swallow-external OL API-007,RUN-018 MUST_NOT ;; Otherwise let external-service failures propagate to centralized handling; do not swallow them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api007.avoid-shapes OL API-007,API-012 AVOID ;; Avoid empty catch blocks and catch/log/rethrow when the global handler logs. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api009.result-optional OL API-009 DEFAULT ;; Result<T> is optional; consider it for several expected failure modes with consistent use; avoid it when null/bool/simple responses are clear or it adds wrapper noise or spreads without need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc020.result-reserved OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Project-wide adoption of a Result pattern is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.result-typed-errors EX API-009 PREFER ;; If a Result pattern is adopted prefer typed errors over string arrays. ;; = ;; Adopted Result pattern. ;; Shape preference not in the oracle.
C x.eh-no-endpoint-filters EX API-010,ARC-010 MUST_NOT ;; In a Controller-based project do not use Minimal API endpoint filters for validation. ;; = ;; none ;; Not stated in error-handling.md or the oracle.

C x.prefer-policies EX SEC-005 PREFER ;; Prefer policies when authorization logic is more than a trivial role check. ;; = ;; none ;; Mechanism preference not in the oracle.
C arc002.auth-types-out-of-domain OL ARC-002 MUST ;; Keep ASP.NET Core transport/authentication types out of Domain. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.auth-scheme-choice EX SEC-016,ARC-020 DEFAULT ;; Choose the scheme by application type: Bearer/OIDC for SPA→API, cookies for server-rendered apps, Identity for owned local accounts, external OIDC/OAuth for delegated identity. ;; = ;; none ;; Scheme-selection mapping not in the oracle.
C gov013.no-speculative-identity OL GOV-013,SEC-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not add ASP.NET Core Identity merely because of a User entity or profile management; use it when the app owns local accounts and needs its account management. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec016.no-custom-jwt OL SEC-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not issue custom JWTs when an existing identity provider owns token issuance. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec016.framework-passwords OL SEC-016,SEC-001 MUST ;; When owning passwords use framework hashing/lockout/reset-token features; never store plaintext passwords or auth secrets in source. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec017.actual-issuer OL SEC-017 MUST ;; Configure Bearer validation per the issuer that actually issues tokens; keys/certificates follow configuration/security rules. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec006.fallback OL SEC-006 MUST ;; A secure global/fallback policy may make repeated [Authorize] unnecessary; mark deliberate exceptions with [AllowAnonymous]. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.policy-constants EX - DEFAULT ;; Use stable constants for repeated policy names. ;; = ;; none ;; Code-hygiene convention not in the oracle.
C x.auth-roles EX SEC-005 PREFER ;; Roles only for genuinely role-oriented models; avoid scattered compound role strings; prefer policies for capabilities spanning roles/claims. ;; = ;; none ;; Modelling preference not in the oracle.
C sec005.resource-authz OL SEC-005 MUST ;; Resource-dependent permissions via ASP.NET Core resource authorization or explicit Application authorization logic. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api005.hiding-404 OL API-005 MUST ;; A deliberate, consistent 404 for some forbidden lookups can avoid disclosing existence. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc007.current-user-abstraction OL ARC-007,ARC-008 MUST ;; When use cases repeatedly need caller identity define a small Application abstraction with an outer HTTP adapter. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc008.no-httpcontext-in-app OL ARC-008 MUST_NOT ;; Application services do not depend directly on HttpContext, ClaimsPrincipal or IHttpContextAccessor. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov012.no-needless-icurrentuser OL GOV-012 MUST_NOT ;; Do not create ICurrentUser when passing an explicit user identifier is simpler. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec001.no-signing-secrets OL SEC-001 MUST_NOT ;; Never commit signing secrets. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.auth-testing EX TST-003,SEC-005 DEFAULT ;; Test authorization for important protected operations: unauthenticated→401, unauthorized→403, permitted success, ownership rules, intended anonymous access. ;; = ;; none ;; Security test obligations not in the oracle.
C tst003.observable-auth OL TST-003 MUST ;; Verify observable authorization behaviour rather than the presence of [Authorize]. ;; = ;; none ;;
